name: Ai Akiyama
source:
[url=/c77543]Koichi[/url]'s Younger sister. She paid a visit to him.

Soon after she moves in with Him, she claims that she wants to become a game developer too, so her brother has to teach her everything he knows. 

The only problem is that she wants to create Hentai games, which puts him in a dubious position.
